text_block_list.name: Northern Children
text_block_list.text: Tora-chaaaan!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is everyone... maybe feeling super 
energetic?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The faces of the northern children running 
over looked brighter than they had before.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
How are you doing? Have you made any 
progress going home since then?

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a lot of them are able to go back 
home now...!

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text:
"On the contrary, you know? The shelter 
feels a little lonelier now..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. Well, that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Northern Child C
text_block_list.text:
"Still... what a shame... I thought I was 
finally gonna get to see Tora-chan running 
in a race~."

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We were so excited to "all go 
together if we could."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ah, about that...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Does everyone really want to watch a 
race? I'd think it's still a pretty 
difficult time right now, but..."

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text: Ah, Transcend-san. Hello, welcome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, a friendly face from the 
neighborhood association came over.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for always relying on you for 
everything. First off... how about we grab 
a light bite to eat?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about me... I'd feel bad 
making you go to the trouble~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Huh, Trai-chan?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I gladly accepted because someone from 
the neighborhood association looked like 
they had something on their mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the shelter, where the crowd had 
thinned out considerably, I enjoyed a 
bento lunch.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh man, thanks for treating me, and sorry 
about this. I really ought to be the one 
bringing refreshments.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text: Not at all... Um, more importantly――

text_block_list.name: Tran & Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text: Wait, let me explain...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them said it at the exact same 
time.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we said that in unison! My apologies. 
Please, go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text: No, no, it's from Transcend-san...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, go right ahead! Go right 
ahead-head-head!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
"Please, make yourself at home. No need to 
be so formal."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? *cough* Well then, allow me 
to go first...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Transcend takes a breath—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Um... It's being held at an alternative 
venue, right? This year's Mile 
Championship Nambu Hai, that is.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I completely assumed no one would be 
interested, but it seems that isn't the 
case...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, um... honestly speaking, how are 
things over there?

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text: That topic, huh? Um... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
Of course, for a while after the disaster 
occurred, we couldn't even think about 
everyday pleasures.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
I had my hands full just trying to secure 
food, clothing, and shelter, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Right...

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it won't stay that way forever. 
That's something I've learned firsthand 
from experience, though..."

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
The situation in the disaster areas 
changes drastically by the day. Along with 
our own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Growing bigger day by day... Along with 
these feelings...

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes... We won't just sit here and wallow 
in defeat, either.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
First, physical and mental health. Next, 
food. Then, a peaceful place to live... 
I'll work hard to regain them one by one.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
"In the midst of all that... the goodwill 
of those around me was something I was 
truly grateful for. Especially one person 
in particular..."

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
Transcend-san. I am truly grateful that 
you rushed over to help in that severe 
cold.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
N-No... If I was able to help even a 
little, then I'm glad. I'll continue to do 
my best.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
Transcend-san... That is what I wanted to 
talk about... today.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text: Transcend-san, are you—

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you suffering more than necessary? 
All because you worry for us.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What do you mean, 'more than 
necessary'...?

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
"We are very grateful that you care about 
us so much. However..."

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
In the daily life of the past, the one we 
long to return to, you were...

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
She was shining at the racetrack. Running 
with all her might, full of smiles.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
The children were really looking forward 
to spending time with you.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
You weren't like this before. You didn't 
come to this land out of goodwill or to 
support anyone...

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
I think they came simply to have a good 
time.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...... Just... a fun time...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The locals were watching closely. They saw 
Transcend for who she truly was.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By nature, Transcend is an Umamusume 
brimming with curiosity. A pained, 
troubled expression is not how her face is 
meant to look.

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
"We will keep moving forward. One step at 
a time. That's why..."

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to be able to smile in that 
very same way too."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: To me... in the exact same way...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I... see... So that was it...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The situation was... changing... Faster 
than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's just that I was so crushed, I had 
closed my heart off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems we haven't kept things up to 
date. And right now, what everyone is 
gradually asking for is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her friend Transcend, once again— shining 
brilliantly and full of energy on the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to see it. They're wishing... for 
me to..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you very much! I understand 
now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I heard they were hurting just as much as 
me. Now I can look forward with even more 
confidence...!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. Best of luck. Our Mile Championship 
Nambu Hai will be held far away this year, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text:
If you, who support them with all your 
heart, are going to enter, then surely—

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Member
text_block_list.text: This is our beloved home race.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, sorry. Looks like... I got the 
wrong idea.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Racing has nothing to do with my everyday 
life. That's how I was starting to 
feel..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“No, that can't be true. Our bond just 
momentarily frayed, that's all...”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
My running is connected to everyone, isn't 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That much was certain. What's more—
choice_data_list:
From here on, let's provide support in our 
own unique way.

From here on, let's offer the kind of 
support only we can give.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Something only we could do...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are other people supporting the 
disaster areas. And people making 
donations too. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To run to give hope to that land and bring 
joy to everyone—Transcend is the only one 
who can do it.
choice_data_list:
Let's show them an even more fun 
day-to-day life!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Even more fun... Yeah, even further 
beyond than before..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Toward days where we can live in peace... 
and experience even more thrills!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Nice, so nice. Trainie... I won't lose 
sight of it anymore."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Just like everyone else is getting back 
on their feet, I'll show you that I can 
stand back up too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Time begins to move once more. And so, the 
season of stagnation came to an end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In step with the recovery of the northern 
lands, Transcend slowly began moving 
forward once again.
